tools.name: bugate_assess
tools.description: Assess a persisted task-local claim; submit=true asks for bounded completion rework.

tools.name: bugate_check_scope
tools.description: Check the current scope and plan references, conflicts and source gaps; structural validity does not establish semantic necessity.

tools.name: bugate_prepare
tools.description: Prepare the current exact-bound quality protocol context.

tools.name: bugate_record_artifact
tools.description: Validate and atomically register a task-local draft; the shared core computes content digests and enforces compare-and-swap updates.

tools.name: bugate_record_evidence
tools.description: Import task-local material; reported execution fields cannot become host observations.

tools.name: bugate_record_scope
tools.description: Record a source-backed acceptance scope draft or an explicitly sourced revision. User authorization must reference host-captured requests; an agent statement of consent is not authority.

tools.name: bugate_record_suggestion
tools.description: Record a non-executable out-of-scope suggestion. Suggestions neither authorize tests nor block acceptance completion; do not expand them into test plans.

tools.name: bugate_run_test
tools.description: Run a host-configured required scenario or a scope-declared auxiliary/diagnostic activity. The core checks the exact current scope and plan and durably preserves actual failures before returning.

tools.name: bugate_scope
tools.description: Read the active acceptance scope, its source receipts and history. Scope is the finite user objective, not a default test matrix.

tools.name: bugate_status
tools.description: Read derived quality facts and assessment freshness.

tools.name: bugate_validate
tools.description: Validate current task structure, references and deterministic rules.
